name: Úlairë Lemenya
subtitle: Assailing Minion
game_text:
Ulairë Lemenya is strength +1 for each other <culture>Wraith</culture> minion you can spot.
While you can spot 3 <culture>Wraith</culture> minions Úlairë Lemenya is <keyword>fierce</keyword>.
While you can spot 4 <culture>Wraith</culture> minions Úlairë Lemenya is <keyword>damage +1</keyword>.
